Este resultado reaparece en el bloque de: This result reappears in the cybernetics block, in [[cib-variedad]], under another name and from another problem. Ross Ashby, studying how a system is regulated, defined the variety of something as the number of different states it can present, and measured it by taking its base-two logarithm.
